questions.q: Who should beginner creators create for first, per lesson 1?
a: Themselves, as an audience of one
questions.why: Lesson 1 says to start by creating for yourself.

questions.q: What is one reason creating for yourself helps?
a: It builds internal motivation instead of reliance on accolades
questions.why: Lesson 1 says it cultivates internal motivation.

questions.q: What does lesson 2 say you need besides work?
a: Time away from your craft to build a relationship with yourself
questions.why: Lesson 2 says time away is needed.

questions.q: What is a prerequisite to finding your unique voice?
questions.why: Lesson 2 says trust is a prerequisite.

questions.q: What myth does lesson 3 want you to abandon?
questions.why: Lesson 3 says no artist exists in a void.
